Resumen del fútbol.

Crystal Palace sack boss Sage after 16 games.
Crystal Palace have sacked manager Pierre Sage after 16 games in charge and the club bottom of the table.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

The chaos that took Carrick from two-year deal to sacked within 15 games.
Michael Carrick becomes the third Manchester United manager to be sacked in three seasons - where did it go wrong?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Six matches that defined Carrick's Man Utd tenure.
BBC Sport looks back at the six Premier League matches that defined the highs and lows of Michael Carrick's 10-month spell in charge of Manchester United.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Kane's top 10 England moments - which was your favourite?.
BBC Sport looks at 10 of Harry Kane's most iconic England moments as he prepares to break his country's caps record.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Robertson set to make history but his hero Dalglish will always be King.
Ties bind Scotland captain Andy Robertson and the man whose caps record he's about to equal, Kenny Dalglish, in more ways than one, writes Tom English.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Actualidad internacional.

England's Blues brothers - how the Bellinghams helped save Birmingham.
Boyhood Birmingham City fans Jude and Jobe Bellingham could become the first brothers to play for England for 19 years.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Young duo at heart of Nations League's meanest defence.
With Northern Ireland yet to concede a goal in the 2026-27 Nations League, young defenders Ruairi McConville and Tom Atcheson have been impressing for Michael O'Neill's side.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

How 'Barca way' continues despite big-name exits.
Arsenal face a much-changed Barcelona in the Women's Champions League on Thursday - but how have the Spanish giants coped so well with losing key players?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

'Unfinished business' - Tuchel committed to England.
England head coach Thomas Tuchel says he has "no intention" of leaving the job before Euro 2028 regardless of any offers from major clubs.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Arsenal join Scott chase - Thursday's gossip.
Arsenal contact Bournemouth about midfielder Alex Scott, Manchester United add two defenders to list of potential targets, Aston Villa weigh up move for Chelsea midfielder Romeo Lavia, plus more.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Últimas noticias del fútbol.

USA withdraw from U17 World Cup.
The USA pull out of the Under-17 World Cup, which starts in Qatar next week, because of the risk of armed conflict.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Wales' James warns of Norwegian revenge in Oslo.
Winger Dan James says Wales proved a point when they beat Norway – but is wary Erling Haaland's team will now want to do the same to them.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Leader, role model, extraordinary - how Kane's 'fairytale' came true.
From the 21-year-old who scored 79 seconds into his debut to being on the brink of breaking his nation's appearance record, BBC Sport looks at Harry Kane's England career.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Spain boss denies Lamine Yamal gets 'special privileges'.
Spain head coach Luis de la Fuente denies claims Lamine Yamal received "special privileges" after being allowed to join the national team later than the rest of the squad.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Police investigation into Vigar's death ongoing.
The police investigation into Billy Vigar's death from a "significant brain injury" is unlikely to conclude for at least another two months.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
